title: Wedding Registry Days on a Finch Circle Courtesy Reissue — Registry Consultant Note
content:
**Note.** For a courtesy reissue of a Finch Note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the courtesy registry days are 14 when the customer has an active Wedding Registry whose event date falls 0 to 90 calendar days after the request date, 7 when it falls more than 90 and up to 180 days after, and 0 otherwise.

The registry is the customer's own Wedding Registry under Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, in active status, and its event date is compared with the request date.

| Event date of the active Wedding Registry, counted from the request date | Courtesy registry days |
|---|---|
| 0 to 90 calendar days after | 14 |
| 91 to 180 calendar days after | 7 |
| before the request date, more than 180 days after, or no active Wedding Registry | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Request on 1 April, wedding on 30 June (90 days later): 14.
- Wedding on 1 July (91 days later): 7.
- An active Housewarming Registry and no Wedding Registry: 0.
